panels.description: Alex answers quietly while looking toward the sketch. Leave upper-left clear.
The daughter waits attentively. Leave the upper third clear.
Alex continues while looking toward the sketch and watch. Leave upper-left clear.

The grease-stained sketch dissolves into the rust, charcoal and oxidized-orange Keel pump hall in 2043. Eighteen-year-old Alex has one palm on the pump housing. Leave upper-left machinery haze clear for the caption.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: When I was a teenager, I had nothing. We hardly had any water...
